title: Temporal Rifts
description: Temporal Rifts is a pack made around world exploration and dimensional travel
body:
Temporal Rifts is a lightweight pack, with servers in mind. It is aimed to not be too intensive to users who prefer a vanilla feel but provide enough variety for those players wanting to have new ways to explore their worlds. A few of the most central mods include:
- Applied Energistics
- Sophisticated Backpacks/Storage
- Tardis Refined
- Tempad
- Twilight Forest
- Artifacts
- Etc.

This pack is a work in progress and all features in it are subject to change.

Any discussions, bug reporting, or suggestions will be done through the discord. You can join it here: https://discord.gg/2ahkHeMCap
